text:
Silver Price in 1972
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1972, the LBMA silver price rose 35.5% between 1972-01-31 ($1.50) and 1972-12-29 ($2.03). The highest sampled price was $2.03 in December and the lowest was $1.47 in February. The mean of these observations was $1.70. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
